title: SB2418 (110th General Assembly): As enacted, exempts from the firing range and classroom hours requirements to obtain a handgun carry permit anyone who in the five years preceding the date of application has successfully completed a department of correction firearms qualification. - Amends TCA Section 39-17-1351.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Chaptered, 2018-05-03; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514062427 of https://publications.tnsosfiles.com/acts/110/pub/pc0865.pdf (LegiScan doc 1802977))
provenance.note: Chaptered, Public Chapter 865, 2018-05-03, effective January 1, 2019. Printed as House Bill 1038 (substituted for SB 2418); adds new subdivision (5) to subsection (e) of 39-17-1351. The summary describes the five-year window and the range and classroom waiver; the quoted words are all the text adds.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1351(e)): (5) Successfully completed Tennessee department of correction firearms qualification.
